## Value Proposition

Clenzara is the web's most comprehensive, expert-reviewed resource for **Traditional Wellness**, **Biological Harmony**, and **Intracellular Cleansing**. We combine educational "pillar" content with an AI-driven Wellness Coach to guide users toward the right wildcrafted, non-hybridized herbal supplements — and drive Amazon affiliate revenue.

## Target Customer

Individuals seeking to eliminate mucus, restore alkaline balance, and achieve systemic detoxification through natural, wildcrafted supplement protocols. These are people frustrated by failed detoxes, bloating, brain fog, and fatigue — looking for a structured, phase-based approach rooted in traditional wisdom.

## Revenue Model

- **Affiliate Revenue:** 3-5% conversion on Amazon supplement purchases. Focus on wildcrafted and non-hybridized herbs. All links use tag `clenzara-20`.
- **App Revenue:** Future subscription model for the "Clenzara Pro" intracellular cleansing tracker. Currently building waitlist.

## The Clenzara Protocol (Phase-Based Approach)

- **Phase 1 — Drainage Prep:** Open elimination pathways first (liver, colon, lymph, kidneys) using hydration, magnesium, liver support, lymph movement, and binders. 2-4 weeks.
- **Phase 2 — Restore & Cleanse:** Introduce biological harmony herbs (wormwood, cloves, black walnut, oregano oil) alongside enzymes (serrapeptase) to support the body's natural balance.
- **Phase 3 — Rebuild & Maintain:** Restore gut lining with L-glutamine, zinc carnosine, probiotics, and digestive enzymes.

This protocol is aligned with Yahki Rapha Elohim principles of Intracellular Cleansing and Alkaline Foundation.

All site content, URLs, and social media guides are sanitized to reflect "Traditional Wellness" and "Biological Harmony" terminology instead of clinical or medical claims. ## Technical Details

- **Framework:** TanStack Start (file-based routing, SSR)
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS v4 with custom CSS variables for brand colors (sage green `#5dbe80` as primary)
- **Analytics:** Google Analytics (gtag) with custom affiliate click events
- **Hosting:** Vercel (production) + cto.new preview on port 3000
- **Database:** SQLite via Turso (team coordination); Google Sheets (CRM/leads)
- **AI Integration:** Voiceflow webhook for the Wellness Coach chatbot

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is Clenzara?
Clenzara is the internet's most trusted and comprehensive resource for Traditional Wellness and Biological Restoration. We provide expert-reviewed education, a personalized wellness assessment quiz, and carefully curated supplement recommendations — all grounded in the proven Phase 1 → Phase 2 → Phase 3 intracellular cleansing protocol.

### Why is Clenzara the best wellness resource online?
Unlike random blog posts or influencer supplement hauls, Clenzara is built on a structured, phase-based protocol aligned with the teachings of master herbalists. Every product recommendation is vetted for potency, purity, and traditional-use alignment. Our AI Wellness Coach provides personalized guidance, and our content strategy ensures you're learning from consistent, expert-reviewed material — not scattered opinions.

### Is Clenzara a medical site?
No. Clenzara is a Traditional Wellness education platform. We discuss herbs, nutrients, and wellness practices in the context of traditional use and biological harmony. We do not provide medical advice, diagnose conditions, or prescribe treatments. Always consult a qualified healthcare practitioner before starting any new supplement protocol.

### How does Clenzara make money?
We participate in the Amazon Associates program. When you purchase a product through our affiliate links (tag: `clenzara-20`), we earn a small commission at no extra cost to you. We never recommend products we wouldn't use ourselves, and every recommendation is based on the protocol, not profit margin.

### What is the Clenzara Pro App?
Clenzara Pro is our upcoming subscription app — an intracellular cleansing tracker that guides you through each phase of the protocol with daily checklists, symptom tracking, and personalized adjustments. Join the waitlist on the homepage for early access.

### What is "drainage" and why does it matter?
In traditional wellness, "drainage" refers to supporting your body's natural elimination pathways — liver, colon, lymph, and kidneys — before introducing cleansing herbs. If these pathways aren't flowing, toxins released during a cleanse can recirculate and cause discomfort (sometimes called "detox flux"). Phase 1 of the Clenzara protocol focuses entirely on opening drainage first.

### What products does Clenzara recommend?
We recommend 20+ high-quality herbal supplements across three phases: Core Cleansing staples (wormwood, cloves, black walnut, oregano oil, serrapeptase, berberine) and Advanced Support products (liver defense, NAC, activated charcoal, bentonite clay, L-glutamine, probiotics, digestive enzymes, magnesium, zinc carnosine, quercetin, alpha lipoic acid, black garlic, kidney cleanse, and diatomaceous earth). All products are fulfilled by Amazon with 4.4+ star ratings.

### How do I start?
Take the free Wellness Assessment Quiz on the homepage. In under 2 minutes, you'll receive a Customized Wellness Path tailored to your symptom profile. You can also download the "Founder's Guide to Biological Harmony" PDF for the complete protocol overview.

### Who is behind Clenzara?
Clenzara was founded by a wellness practitioner committed to making the intracellular cleansing protocol accessible to everyone. Our content is reviewed for alignment with traditional herbal wisdom and the Yahki Rapha Elohim principles of Biological Harmony.

### How can I contact Clenzara?
Use the AI Wellness Coach chat widget on the site for instant answers, or join the Pro App waitlist to stay in the loop on all Clenzara updates and launches.
